security_audit.summary: The skill performs intended network calls to BrowserAct and reads a BrowserAct API key from the environment. Most static command-execution and reconnaissance hits are Markdown or error-handling false positives, but the guidance to provide API keys in chat is a real credential exposure risk.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide API keys in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY or an approved secret manager instead.
Document that search terms, task IDs, and the bearer token are sent to BrowserAct before the skill runs.
Fix the polling loop so successful completion reaches the result retrieval block instead of returning after the loop.

content.value_statement: Manual news monitoring is slow and inconsistent. This skill starts BrowserAct Google News workflows with structured inputs and polling logs.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Python helper script for BrowserAct Google News workflows.
Reads the BrowserAct API key from BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Accepts search keywords, publish date filters, and a result limit.
Starts a BrowserAct task with a fixed Google News workflow template.
Polls task status and prints timestamped progress logs.
Includes code intended to retrieve the task output string.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and network access to browseract.com.
Sends search terms and the bearer token to the BrowserAct API.
The reviewed script appears to return before the result retrieval block runs.
Does not verify article accuracy or summarize full article text.

use_cases.title: Monitor brand coverage
use_cases.description: Track recent Google News mentions for a company, product, or executive with a selected time range.

use_cases.title: Research market trends
use_cases.description: Collect headlines and sources for emerging topics before preparing a market brief.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor news
use_cases.description: Run focused searches for several competitor names and compare recent media activity.

prompt_templates.title: Search recent topic news
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Google News API skill to find recent news about renewable energy from the past week. Limit results to 10.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor a brand today
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Google News for mentions of Acme Robotics from the past 24 hours. Report headlines, sources, and links.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Run separate Google News searches for Contoso AI and Fabrikam AI from the past week. Compare visible product and funding coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Build a trend brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect Google News results for quantum battery startups from the past year. Group findings by theme and flag repeated sources.

output_examples.input: Search for semiconductor supply chain news from the past week.
output: A list of matching headlines with publishers and publication times.
Direct article links for follow-up reading.
A short note when the BrowserAct task fails or times out.

output_examples.input: Find the latest media coverage for a company in the past 24 hours.
output: Recent headline entries ordered from the BrowserAct response.
Source names and article URLs for each available result.
Status messages showing task start, polling, and completion state.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment or an approved secret manager.
Use narrow date ranges and result limits for faster, more relevant searches.
Open source articles before making factual claims or business decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, chat messages, or shared logs.
Do not run broad searches without a topic, date range, or result limit.
Do not treat headlines as verified facts without reading the article.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set before the script runs.

faq.question: Which service receives my query?
faq.answer: The script sends task requests to the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: Can it search any Google News topic?
faq.answer: It accepts keyword searches, but results depend on BrowserAct and Google News availability.

faq.question: Does it summarize articles?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves structured news result fields and leaves summarization to the agent or user.

faq.question: What date filters are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents any time, past hours, past 24 hours, past week, and past year.

faq.question: Should I share my BrowserAct key in chat?
faq.answer: No. Use an environment variable or an approved secret manager instead.
